items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: He was a rather... Holm? Yeah, Alice Holm. That's right, that's right. That's the one I'm trying to... A little more disciplined.

ctx.x: He was one of the ones and there was another one who I like even better than I do Helms and I can't think of his name. Yes, I know who you mean.
He was a rather... Holm? Yeah, Alice Holm. That's right, that's right. That's the one I'm trying to... A little more disciplined. Helm I couldn't take, I thought he got out of tune just
much too much altogether. Too wild. Too wild.
